comments.t: I’m so glad the cheap option won 😆
I’ve been using castor oil on my eyebrows and eyelashes for a bit. I haven’t seen much change in my lashes but my eyebrows exploded in growth. It insane and I love it.

I suffered from trichotillomania for many years (hair pulling; I used to pull my lashes out for years, awful, I know. It's an anxiety disorder), so I have tried so many serums to get regrowth. I REALLY like Revitalash the most. It's a bit pricey, but sometimes you can get coupon codes (especially with the Dermstore). I also have used the generic form of Latisse and it showed great results (ingredient bimatoprost) which you can buy from an online pharmacy. Finally, Lilash also works well and uses a prostaglandin. I plan on getting more of the generic bimatoprost when I order my retin-a because it's so cheap online.
The best thing to grow your eyelashes - beside castor oil - is not using mascara for at least a month! This did wonders to my lashes! 🥳❤️

Actually, Latisse isn't the only one that has a hormonal effect. Grande lash and others have proglasprostaglandins in them, often times cousins of the prostaglandins we would normally recognize but now we don't because they include slight variations with different names, which are also harmful. The side effects are unfortunately there.

I used and LOVED eye envy after having eyelash extensions for over two years. I had stubs when I had my natural lashes back  and started using it twice a day. I had results in 3  weeks. After that I would use it once a day then went to a few days a week. Everyone I’ve known who’s used eye envy loved it and had results too.

"Your eyelashes are going to communicate with each other". I laughed so loud I couldn't hear a word you said afterward!  
My eyelashes were breaking so I tried castor oil and stopped wearing mascara for a month. It seemed to help repair them.

Thank you so much, Kackie. 
Your video is fantastic and filled with so much useful information. I tried multiple eyelash serums, and few irritated my eyelids or lack of results. I think that the recipe that the company uses is an essential factor.
I bought an eyelash serum from Amazon, and I noticed a big lash and brow growth over two weeks of usage.
It is true that after you stop using it, your hair game will get back to normal, but the company had 5ml of serum, which sufficed me for over three months.
8:26 actually in my case I noticed shedding at my first 3 days of using castor oil,  then after about a week it doesn't fall anymore and it turned thicker and longer.
Awesome experiment! I’m missing some small patches bottom lashes from chemo and I might try this to see if it helps at all!
I was surprised because it doesn’t have prostaglandins, but it works for me. I also use on my eyebrows and am seeing excellent results.
I opted for this lash serum because others are too expensive and have lot of cons, even if it doesn’t end up doing anything its worth a shot

I've used it for maybe two months consistently (morning and night) and have seen slow and steady results.
At first it did sting my eyelids but over time that feeling stopped. It will primarily make your lashes thicker and denser over length but I have seen some change in length. It works great for the eyebrows too! It filled in the holes I have in my brows. Plan to keep using this!

I'm so happy to have found your channel! I have sensitive dry eyes so it's really awesome seeing makeup and serums from a eye-health perspective.. of course I do research, but its nice to see someone else do it for me hahahaha
SO lucky I chose this serum out of the other companies, had no idea topical  Prostaglandins carried such a risk.
Thank you! I was looking for a serum without the side effects mentioned, and I had assumed the ordinary serum would have them too!
I used this serum for about a week and my eyelids looked puffy/sunken in and my eyes were also dry and itchy
It makes my eyes lids go red and my eyes feel very unwell after use which is disappointing because I could see growth
This is very useful thank you so much, I bought this serum but I was scared of side effects like eye color change, phew!
